```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

```{r paths}
base_dir    <- "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean"
mash_dir    <- file.path(base_dir, "results/mash/medianUMI1")
lfc3_dir    <- file.path(mash_dir, "lfc3")
de_dir      <- file.path(base_dir, "results/treatment/dreamlet_1v4_DE")
cormotif_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results/treatment/cormotif/cormotif_15cells_4arm")
out_dir     <- file.path(lfc3_dir, "sharing_characterization")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

drug_colors <- c(Ale = "#4E79A7", Bri = "#F28E2B", Cer = "#59A14F",
                 Cri = "#E15759", Lor = "#B07AA1")
drug_order  <- c("Ale", "Bri", "Cer", "Cri", "Lor")
```

```{r load-response-eqtls}
response_eqtls <- fread(file.path(lfc3_dir, "treatment_responsive_eqtls_signfixed.tsv"))
# gene_snp | gene | celltype | treatment | sig_mode
```


## 1. Response eQTL overview

```{r overview}
drug_summary <- response_eqtls %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    n_eqtl_rows      = n(),
    n_unique_egenes   = n_distinct(gene),
    n_unique_eqtl_pairs = n_distinct(gene_snp)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(treatment, drug_order))

drug_summary
```

```{r overview-plot}
drug_summary_long <- drug_summary %>%
  select(treatment, n_unique_egenes, n_unique_eqtl_pairs) %>%
  pivot_longer(-treatment, names_to = "metric", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(
    metric = recode(metric,
      n_unique_egenes      = "Unique eGenes",
      n_unique_eqtl_pairs  = "Unique gene-SNP pairs"
    ),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = drug_order)
  )

p_overview <- ggplot(drug_summary_long, aes(x = treatment, y = count, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = drug_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count", title = "Response eQTLs per drug (fold-change ≥ 3, lfsr < 0.05)") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_overview)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "01_response_eqtl_counts_per_drug.pdf"), p_overview, width = 7, height = 4)
```


## 2. Pan-drug eGenes: shared across all 5 treatments

How many eGenes are response eQTLs in every drug (in any cell type)?

```{r gene-sharing-tier}
gene_summary <- response_eqtls %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarize(
    n_treatments = n_distinct(treatment),
    n_celltypes  = n_distinct(celltype)
  )

tier_counts <- gene_summary %>%
  count(n_treatments) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
tier_counts
```

```{r tier-barplot}
p_tiers <- ggplot(tier_counts, aes(x = factor(n_treatments), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4E79A7") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", pct, "%)")), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Number of drugs gene is a response eGene in",
       y = "Number of eGenes",
       title = "Response eGene drug-sharing tiers") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_tiers)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "02_egene_sharing_tiers.pdf"), p_tiers, width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r pan-drug-egenes}
pan_drug <- gene_summary %>% filter(n_treatments == 5)
cat("Pan-drug eGenes (response in all 5 drugs):", nrow(pan_drug), "\n")
cat("Median cell types they span:", median(pan_drug$n_celltypes), "\n")
```

```{r pan-drug-celltype-breadth}
p_breadth <- ggplot(pan_drug, aes(x = n_celltypes)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#4E79A7", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "Number of cell types",
       y = "Number of pan-drug eGenes",
       title = "Cell-type breadth of pan-drug response eGenes") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_breadth)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "03_pandrug_celltype_breadth.pdf"), p_breadth, width = 6, height = 4)
```

Which cell types contribute the most pan-drug response eQTL entries?

```{r pan-drug-by-celltype}
pandrug_ct <- response_eqtls %>%
  filter(gene %in% pan_drug$gene) %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarize(n_pandrug_eqtl_rows = n(), n_pandrug_egenes = n_distinct(gene)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_pandrug_egenes)) %>%
  mutate(celltype_label = gsub("_", " ", celltype),
         celltype_label = factor(celltype_label, levels = rev(gsub("_", " ", celltype))))

p_pandrug_ct <- ggplot(pandrug_ct, aes(x = n_pandrug_egenes, y = celltype_label)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4E79A7") +
  labs(x = "Number of pan-drug response eGenes",
       y = NULL,
       title = "Pan-drug response eGenes by cell type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9)
print(p_pandrug_ct)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "04_pandrug_egenes_by_celltype.pdf"), p_pandrug_ct, width = 7, height = 6)
```

Pan-drug eGene sharing tier vs. effect size, do broadly shared eQTLs have larger or smaller effects?

```{r sharing-vs-effect-size}
mash_cols <- fread(file.path(mash_dir, "combined_mash_results.tsv"), nrows = 0) %>% names()
beta_cols  <- grep("_beta$", mash_cols, value = TRUE)
mash_betas <- fread(file.path(mash_dir, "combined_mash_results.tsv"),
                    select = c("gene_snp", beta_cols))

# Median absolute beta across all conditions per gene_snp
mash_betas <- mash_betas %>%
  mutate(median_abs_beta = apply(abs(select(., all_of(beta_cols))), 1, median, na.rm = TRUE))

# Join to gene sharing tier
gene_snp_tier <- response_eqtls %>%
  select(gene_snp, gene) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(gene_summary, by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(mash_betas %>% select(gene_snp, median_abs_beta), by = "gene_snp")

p_effect_by_tier <- ggplot(gene_snp_tier, aes(x = factor(n_treatments), y = median_abs_beta)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "Number of drugs gene is a response eGene in",
       y = "Median |posterior beta| across conditions",
       title = "Effect size by drug-sharing tier") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_effect_by_tier)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "05_effect_size_by_sharing_tier.pdf"), p_effect_by_tier, width = 7, height = 4)
```


## 3. Drug-specific eQTL counts and distribution

```{r drug-specific-load}
treatment_specific <- fread(file.path(lfc3_dir, "treatment_specific_eqtls.tsv"))
# gene_snp | gene | celltype | treatment

drug_specific_summary <- treatment_specific %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    n_unique_egenes    = n_distinct(gene),
    n_unique_eqtl_rows = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(treatment, drug_order))

drug_specific_summary
```

```{r drug-specific-barplot}
p_specific <- drug_specific_summary %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = drug_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = treatment, y = n_unique_egenes, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = drug_colors) +

       title = "Drug-specific response eGenes (response in that drug only)") +

print(p_specific)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "06_drug_specific_egene_counts.pdf"), p_specific, width = 6, height = 4)
```

Drug-specific eQTL distribution across cell types:

```{r drug-specific-heatmap}
drug_specific_ct <- treatment_specific %>%
  group_by(celltype, treatment) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(gene), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(celltype, treatment = drug_order, fill = list(n = 0))

drug_specific_mat <- drug_specific_ct %>%
  mutate(celltype = gsub("_", " ", celltype)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("celltype") %>%
  as.matrix()
drug_specific_mat <- drug_specific_mat[, drug_order]

pheatmap(drug_specific_mat,
         cluster_cols  = FALSE,
         cluster_rows  = TRUE,
         color         = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#4E79A7"))(50),
         main          = "Drug-specific response eGenes per cell type",
         fontsize_row  = 8,
         fontsize_col  = 10,
         filename      = file.path(out_dir, "07_drug_specific_eqtl_heatmap.pdf"),
         width = 7, height = 7)
pheatmap(drug_specific_mat,
         cluster_cols  = FALSE,
         cluster_rows  = TRUE,
         color         = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#4E79A7"))(50),
         main          = "Drug-specific response eGenes per cell type",
         fontsize_row  = 8,
         fontsize_col  = 10)
```

Fraction of response eQTLs that are drug-specific, per cell type:

```{r drug-specific-fraction}
total_per_ct_drug <- response_eqtls %>%
  group_by(celltype, treatment) %>%
  summarize(n_total = n_distinct(gene), .groups = "drop")

specific_per_ct_drug <- treatment_specific %>%
  group_by(celltype, treatment) %>%
  summarize(n_specific = n_distinct(gene), .groups = "drop")

frac_specific <- total_per_ct_drug %>%
  left_join(specific_per_ct_drug, by = c("celltype", "treatment")) %>%
  mutate(n_specific  = replace_na(n_specific, 0),
         frac_specific = n_specific / n_total)

frac_specific_summary <- frac_specific %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(mean_frac = mean(frac_specific, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_frac = median(frac_specific, na.rm = TRUE))
frac_specific_summary
```

## 4. Cell type × treatment heatmap of all response eQTLs

```{r ct-treatment-heatmap}
ct_trt_counts <- response_eqtls %>%
  group_by(celltype, treatment) %>%
  summarize(n_egenes = n_distinct(gene), n_eqtls = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(celltype, treatment = drug_order, fill = list(n_egenes = 0, n_eqtls = 0))

make_ct_trt_matrix <- function(df, value_col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(celltype = gsub("_", " ", celltype)) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = celltype, names_from = treatment, values_from = all_of(value_col),
                values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("celltype") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    .[, drug_order]
}

mat_egenes <- make_ct_trt_matrix(ct_trt_counts, "n_egenes")
mat_eqtls  <- make_ct_trt_matrix(ct_trt_counts, "n_eqtls")

pheatmap(mat_egenes,
         cluster_cols  = FALSE,
         cluster_rows  = TRUE,
         color         = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#B07AA1", "#4E79A7"))(50),
         main          = "Response eGenes per cell type × drug",
         fontsize_row  = 8,
         fontsize_col  = 10,
         filename      = file.path(out_dir, "08_ct_drug_egene_heatmap.pdf"),
         width = 7, height = 7)
pheatmap(mat_egenes,
         cluster_cols  = FALSE,
         cluster_rows  = TRUE,
         color         = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#B07AA1", "#4E79A7"))(50),
         main          = "Response eGenes per cell type × drug",
         fontsize_row  = 8,
         fontsize_col  = 10)
```

Are cell types consistent across drugs (do the row patterns look similar), or does each drug have a different leading cell type?

```{r ct-consistency}
# Spearman correlations between drugs across cell types (using n_egenes)
drug_cors <- cor(mat_egenes, method = "spearman")
cat("Spearman correlations between drugs (response eGene counts across cell types):\n")
round(drug_cors, 3)

pheatmap(drug_cors,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format   = "%.2f",
         color           = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#4E79A7"))(50),
         main            = "Drug–drug correlation in response eGene counts per cell type",
         filename        = file.path(out_dir, "09_drug_drug_ct_correlation.pdf"),
         width = 5, height = 4.5)
pheatmap(drug_cors,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format   = "%.2f",
         color           = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#4E79A7"))(50),
         main            = "Drug–drug correlation in response eGene counts per cell type")
```

## 6. Cross-reference with cormotif motifs

Do response eGenes preferentially belong to non-null cormotif patterns? And do drug-specific response eGenes overlap with the corresponding drug's cormotif motif?

```{r load-cormotif}
gene_lists    <- fread(file.path(cormotif_dir, "S2_gene_lists.csv"))
# cell_type | motif | gene  (non-null motif members only)
motif_patterns <- fread(file.path(cormotif_dir, "motif_pattern_table.csv"))
# cell_type | motif | drug_pattern | is_null | motif_type | ...

gene_lists_annot <- gene_lists %>%
  left_join(motif_patterns %>% select(cell_type, motif, drug_pattern, is_null, motif_type),
            by = c("cell_type", "motif")) %>%
  mutate(celltype = gsub(" ", "_", cell_type))
```

### 6a. What fraction of response eGenes are in cormotif non-null motifs?

```{r cormotif-overlap}
# Unique gene × celltype for response eQTLs
response_gene_ct <- response_eqtls %>%
  select(gene, celltype) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(is_response_egene = TRUE)

# All genes tested in eQTL (from combined_mash_results gene column)
all_egene_ct <- fread(file.path(mash_dir, "combined_mash_results.tsv"),
                      select = c("gene_snp")) %>%
  mutate(gene = sub("_[^_]+:[^_]+:[^_]+$", "", gene_snp)) %>%
  select(gene) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(is_any_egene = TRUE)

# Join response eGenes to cormotif
response_cormotif <- response_gene_ct %>%
  left_join(
    gene_lists_annot %>% select(celltype, gene, drug_pattern, is_null, motif_type),
    by = c("gene", "celltype")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    in_cormotif = !is.na(drug_pattern),
    motif_class = case_when(
      !in_cormotif  ~ "Not in cormotif",
      is_null        ~ "Null motif",
      motif_type == "mixed" ~ "Mixed motif",
      TRUE           ~ "Drug-specific/active motif"
    )
  )

motif_class_summary <- response_cormotif %>%
  count(motif_class) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
motif_class_summary
```

```{r cormotif-overlap-plot}
p_motif_class <- ggplot(motif_class_summary,
                         aes(x = "", y = n, fill = motif_class)) +
  geom_col(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Cormotif membership of response eGene × cell type pairs",
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_void()
print(p_motif_class)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "12_response_egene_cormotif_class.pdf"), p_motif_class,
       width = 6, height = 5)
```

### 6b. Do drug-specific eQTL genes overlap their drug's cormotif?

For each drug, test: are drug-specific eQTL genes enriched among genes in that drug's cormotif motif?

```{r cormotif-drug-specific-overlap}
drug_specific_cormotif <- treatment_specific %>%
  left_join(
    gene_lists_annot %>% select(celltype, gene, drug_pattern, is_null, motif_type),
    by = c("gene", "celltype")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    drug_in_pattern = mapply(function(dp, trt) {
      if (is.na(dp)) return(FALSE)
      grepl(trt, dp, fixed = TRUE)
    }, drug_pattern, treatment)
  )

overlap_summary <- drug_specific_cormotif %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    n_drug_specific_egenes   = n_distinct(gene),
    n_in_matching_cormotif   = n_distinct(gene[drug_in_pattern & !is.na(drug_pattern)]),
    pct_in_matching_cormotif = round(100 * n_in_matching_cormotif / n_drug_specific_egenes, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(treatment, drug_order))

overlap_summary
```

```{r cormotif-fisher-per-drug}
# Background: all genes in cormotif database (any cell type) that are also eGenes
cormotif_egenes <- gene_lists_annot %>%
  filter(celltype %in% unique(response_eqtls$celltype)) %>%
  select(gene, celltype, drug_pattern) %>%
  distinct()

fisher_results <- lapply(drug_order, function(trt) {
  # Drug-specific eQTL genes (any cell type)
  spec_genes <- unique(treatment_specific$gene[treatment_specific$treatment == trt])
  # Non-drug-specific response eGenes
  all_resp_genes <- unique(response_eqtls$gene)
  non_spec_genes <- setdiff(all_resp_genes, spec_genes)

  # Cormotif membership: does drug appear in drug_pattern?
  in_trt_cormotif <- cormotif_egenes %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarize(in_trt = any(grepl(trt, drug_pattern, fixed = TRUE))) %>%
    filter(gene %in% all_resp_genes)

  a <- sum(in_trt_cormotif$gene %in% spec_genes & in_trt_cormotif$in_trt)     # specific + in motif
  b <- sum(in_trt_cormotif$gene %in% spec_genes & !in_trt_cormotif$in_trt)    # specific + not in motif
  c <- sum(!(in_trt_cormotif$gene %in% spec_genes) & in_trt_cormotif$in_trt)  # non-specific + in motif
  d <- sum(!(in_trt_cormotif$gene %in% spec_genes) & !in_trt_cormotif$in_trt) # non-specific + not in motif

  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2), alternative = "greater")
  tibble(treatment = trt, OR = ft$estimate, p_value = ft$p.value,
         in_specific = a, total_specific = a + b)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

cat("Fisher test: drug-specific eQTL genes enriched in matching cormotif motif?\n")
fisher_results
```

## 7. Lor characterization

```{r lor-overview}
lor_eqtls <- response_eqtls %>% filter(treatment == "Lor")
cat("Lor response eQTL rows:", nrow(lor_eqtls), "\n")
cat("Lor unique eGenes:", n_distinct(lor_eqtls$gene), "\n")
cat("Lor unique gene_snp pairs:", n_distinct(lor_eqtls$gene_snp), "\n")
```

```{r lor-celltype-distribution}
lor_ct <- lor_eqtls %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarize(n_egenes = n_distinct(gene)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_egenes)) %>%
  mutate(celltype_label = factor(gsub("_", " ", celltype),
                                  levels = rev(gsub("_", " ", celltype))))

p_lor_ct <- ggplot(lor_ct, aes(x = n_egenes, y = celltype_label)) +
  geom_col(fill = drug_colors["Lor"]) +
  labs(x = "Response eGenes", y = NULL,
       title = "Lor response eGenes by cell type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9)
print(p_lor_ct)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "13_lor_egenes_by_celltype.pdf"), p_lor_ct, width = 7, height = 6)
```

Are Lor effect sizes larger than other drugs, consistent with a dose-driven response?

```{r lor-effect-sizes}
lor_beta_cols <- grep("_Lor_beta$", mash_cols, value = TRUE)
mash_lor_betas <- fread(file.path(mash_dir, "combined_mash_results.tsv"),
                        select = c("gene_snp", lor_beta_cols)) %>%
  mutate(gene = sub("_[^_]+:[^_]+:[^_]+$", "", gene_snp),
         median_lor_beta = apply(abs(select(., all_of(lor_beta_cols))), 1, function(x) median(x[x > 0], na.rm = TRUE)))

# Comparable median beta for each drug (across their specific beta columns)
drug_beta_medians <- lapply(drug_order, function(trt) {
  cols <- grep(paste0("_", trt, "_beta$"), mash_cols, value = TRUE)
  fread(file.path(mash_dir, "combined_mash_results.tsv"), select = c("gene_snp", cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_snp, names_to = "condition", values_to = "beta") %>%
    filter(abs(beta) > 0) %>%
    group_by(gene_snp) %>%
    summarize(median_abs_beta = median(abs(beta), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(treatment = trt)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Only for response eQTL gene_snps in each drug
drug_beta_response <- drug_beta_medians %>%
  semi_join(response_eqtls %>% select(gene_snp, treatment), by = c("gene_snp", "treatment")) %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = drug_order))

p_lor_effects <- ggplot(drug_beta_response, aes(x = treatment, y = median_abs_beta, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = drug_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Median |posterior beta| across cell types",
       title = "Response eQTL effect sizes by drug") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_lor_effects)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "14_effect_sizes_by_drug.pdf"), p_lor_effects, width = 7, height = 4)

# Wilcoxon test: Lor vs others
lor_betas     <- drug_beta_response$median_abs_beta[drug_beta_response$treatment == "Lor"]
nonlor_betas  <- drug_beta_response$median_abs_beta[drug_beta_response$treatment != "Lor"]
wt <- wilcox.test(lor_betas, nonlor_betas, alternative = "greater")
cat("Wilcoxon test (Lor > others in |beta|): p =", format(wt$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
```

cat("Cell types with Lor-specific eQTLs:", n_distinct(lor_specific$celltype), "\n")

lor_specific_ct <- lor_specific %>%
  group_by(celltype) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(gene)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
